head: e9e35067fc3b419a54d790a71663071455f203f1
profile: release, block-v2-wide-lanes + gpu, crate x86-64-v3 configuration
implementation: Owned main traces and quotient evaluations remain on the GPU for multiple AIRs.
Quotient commitments flatten in AIR/chunk order, retain per-AIR bounds, and enforce an aggregate 256-matrix limit before main randomness.
Machine preprocessing commits multiple GPU-generated traces together and preserves CPU verifier metadata order.
Witness and randomness worker checks include aggregate live storage; existing assignment schemas and individual bounds remain enforced.
Equal padded AIR heights and quotient chunk heights are required; unsupported geometry and foreign sessions reject before commitment draws.

preserved_attempts.run-01: Witness success fixture underestimated symbolic host storage; complete-proof selectors were wrong. Randomness resource test passed.
preserved_attempts.run-02: Unequal output heights rejected in resident preprocessing; this exposed the retained engine's existing equal-height requirement.
preserved_attempts.run-03: Resource tests and 50-partition commitments passed. Four GPU batch proofs matched CPU bytes; verifier key RNG reuse and CPU-transcript test environment required corrections.
preserved_attempts.run-04: Resource tests passed; GPU tests stopped at a lease held by a separate benchmark campaign.
preserved_attempts.run-05: Resource and quotient tests passed; new receipt test incorrectly requested a cached child component on a standalone run.
preserved_attempts.run-06: Four CPU-randomness compatibility batch proofs passed complete CPU verification; strict GPU test needed production backend capability initialization.
preserved_attempts.run-07: Resource tests passed; GPU test stopped at the other campaign's lease.
preserved_attempts.run-08: Controller waited passively for the other campaign and the quotient comparison passed. The production-initialized batch test needed its old manual engine initialization removed to avoid changing limits.
preserved_attempts.run-09: Quadratic quotient, 50-partition commitment, resource tests and four compatibility proofs passed. Strict proof receipt correctly rejected a missing witness observation; the test now uses the dedicated production witness observer.
preserved_attempts.run-10: All native checks executed passed, including four GPU-required batch proofs and their complete receipts. Controller incorrectly allowed only one lookup/quotient orchestration measurement; corrected to exactly one per AIR.
preserved_attempts.run-11: All native checks executed passed, including singleton regressions. Controller counted deliberately rejected negative-test receipts as successful proofs; now separates success and exactly seven negative receipts per singleton suite.

limitations: The 14 GPU-required registered-proof receipts exclude public statement derivation; eight are three-AIR batch proofs and six are singleton regressions.
Eight additional batch proofs use CPU randomness/transcripts for compatibility and are not all-GPU arithmetic proofs.

Complete batch qualification covers three 64-row cubic MachineAir instances and 48 quotient matrices; component tests cover 50 quotient matrices. The 256-matrix admission bound is not a capacity benchmark.
Mixed output heights still require new GPU tree, salt-order and owned-query work. Callers must explicitly pad compatible programs before setup.

Batches retain upstream joint global-lookup semantics. MachineAir uses a named global wire bus; independently scheduled transactions need separate proofs or explicitly designed and verified bus isolation.
No new public worker packet, registry profile, consensus activation, recursive aggregation or native delivery path is introduced.

Synthetic correctness tests establish no transactions-per-hour figure. Sustained throughput, multi-GPU scaling, full-size recursion, AMD/Metal and the local Mac source checkpoint remain separate work.
